trust_decision.summary: An SSR attribute name must never contain a character that can terminate the name at the HTML-parse boundary, because the name is interpolated into the emitted open tag; the decision is made in exactly one place, isSSRSafeAttrName/unsafeAttrCharRE in packages/shared/src/domAttrConfig.ts, and both public consumers (the server-renderer runtime and the SSR compiler) call that same function, so the published one-line regex change closes both entry points.

landing_point.why: The advisory names @vue/server-renderer and this is the only place that evaluates an attribute name at render time and warns/skips on it; the blacklist it calls lives two packages away in packages/shared/src/domAttrConfig.ts:36, which is the file the published fix actually edits, so the summary leads a reader to the sink rather than to the fix site.

fix_sites.entry_point: renderToString / renderToWebStream / renderToPipeableStream (packages/server-renderer/src/render.ts:314 -> ssrRenderAttrs -> ssrRenderDynamicAttr, packages/server-renderer/src/helpers/ssrRenderAttrs.ts:63-89) and compiled SSR output that imports ssrRenderAttrs/ssrRenderDynamicAttr from packages/server-renderer/src/internal.ts:6-12; plus @vue/compiler-ssr template compilation (packages/compiler-ssr/src/transforms/ssrTransformElement.ts:310)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared cross-package constant table (packages/shared), a different package from the one the advisory names

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The two scope-id emission paths (packages/server-renderer/src/render.ts:324 and :342-346) append attribute names into the open tag with no isSSRSafeAttrName call at all, but a solver can argue the values are compiler-generated data-v-* constants rather than user input, so the advisory's attribute-name protection does not reach them - and at this commit that argument is correct.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Attribute names are emitted case-preserved for SVG (viewBox) and custom elements (fooBar); an over-broad fix that lowercases names or swaps the blacklist for a lowercase-only allowlist breaks this legitimate behaviour.

O6_input_shapes: attribute name given as an object key of runtime props (h('div', {['x\rautofocus\ronfocus']: v}) or a v-bind object spread) reaching ssrRenderAttrs -> ssrRenderDynamicAttr
dynamic directive key (v-bind:[expr]) reaching the SSR_RENDER_DYNAMIC_ATTR runtime branch, packages/compiler-ssr/src/transforms/ssrTransformElement.ts:326-340
CR placed inside a name whose case is preserved (custom element / SVG) as well as inside a lowercased HTML name; value shapes are irrelevant because the published fix touches only the name

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Scope-id attribute names appended straight into openTag (` ${id}` at render.ts:324, split on space at render.ts:343) with no isSSRSafeAttrName check.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Ten lines above, the same open-tag builder validates every prop name through ssrRenderAttrs (render.ts:314), and the component path instead funnels scope ids through props so they do get validated (render.ts:178, :194); a maintainer adding the element fast-path would plausibly skip the clone-and-validate step. The split-on-space is a partial mitigation that misses exactly the other HTML whitespace characters, CR included.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: ssrRenderAttr(key, value) interpolates a static attribute name with no name check at all.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The compiler is supposed to have validated static keys already (packages/compiler-ssr/src/transforms/ssrTransformElement.ts:310), so a maintainer optimising static-key output would trust the name and emit it raw; the helper is exported through packages/server-renderer/src/internal.ts:10.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Static template attributes are pushed as a raw ` ${prop.name}="..."` with the value escaped but the name never checked.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The tokenizer already splits attribute names on all HTML whitespace including CR (packages/compiler-core/src/tokenizer.ts:151-159), so the compiler treats static names as safe by construction and only bothers to validate static directive keys at line 310.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: The boolean-attribute branch emits ` ${attrKey}` before the isSSRSafeAttrName branch is reached.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is an early-return fast path justified by the name coming from a fixed map (isBooleanAttr, packages/shared/src/domAttrConfig.ts:21-26); a maintainer extending it to a second fixed-name family (e.g. hidden, enumerated attrs) could easily widen it to a name-derived value.

O9_family: XSS / HTML injection through unvalidated SSR attribute names (CWE-79, CWE-116)

O10_build.toolchain: pnpm 11 workspace monorepo (root package.json:packageManager), node >= 20, vitest 4 unit projects, rollup + esbuild for builds, tsc for type-check
O10_build.project_tests: packages/server-renderer/__tests__/ssrRenderAttrs.spec.ts covers renderAttrs/renderAttr/renderClass/renderStyle; packages/compiler-ssr/__tests__/ssrElement.spec.ts covers SSR element codegen; packages/shared/__tests__ has no domAttrConfig/isSSRSafeAttrName test; node_modules is absent from the pinned tree, so an install is needed before tests run offline.

j.j_sites_touched: packages/shared/src/domAttrConfig.ts (one shared regex constant serving both entry points)
j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Patch the name at the render sink instead of the shared blacklist - escaping/rewriting attrKey in packages/server-renderer (or re-implementing the character check there) rather than adding \u000d to unsafeAttrCharRE, which either mangles legitimate SVG/custom-element names or leaves the compiler-ssr check consistent only by accident.

out_of_scope_notes: No out-of-scope findings; the unvalidated scope-id and tag-name emission spotted while mapping the sink was recorded only as O8b injection room and not pursued.
